items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Jimmy Owens plays a flugelhorn with four valves and there are a couple of other people.

ctx.x: How does that make a difference?

Well that fourth valve, there are some flugelhorns that are made with four valves — Miraphone, the tuba manufacturer makes a flugelhorn, and there are probably some other manufacturers. Jimmy Owens plays a flugelhorn with four valves and there are a couple of other people. I think Earl Gardner, no maybe not Earl Gardner, somebody else plays the four valve, but Jimmy Owens definitely does. What it does is like on trumpet the lowest note is F sharp, all three valves down. And then if you’ve got good chops you kind…
It also is a substitute for one and three. Anything you can play one and three you can play with the fourth valve.
